\section{Hypercontractivity --- Applications --- KKL}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.Applications.KKL
\subsection*{Hypercontractivity --- Applications --- KKL: Introduction}
The full variance-scaled KKL theorem and its edge-isoperimetric strengthening give large coordinate influences. A further consequence locates a large nonempty Fourier coefficient at degree controlled by total influence.

\subsection*{Hypercontractivity --- Applications --- KKL: Results}

\difficulty{5}
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ take only the values $-1$
and $1$. Assume $\operatorname{Var}(f)>0$, and set $I=I[f]/\operatorname{Var}(f)$, where
$I[f]$ is the sum of the coordinate influences. Then $\frac{9}{I^2}9^{-I}\le M(f)$,
where $M(f)$ is the supremum of the absolute coordinate influences (with the empty
supremum interpreted as $0$).
\end{theorem}

\begin{lemma}[Variance-scaled coordinate influence bound]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.exists_influence_ge_kkl_bound}

\difficulty{6}
Let $n\ge2$ and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ take values only in $\{-1,1\}$. Under the
uniform measure on the Boolean cube, some coordinate $i$ satisfies
$\operatorname{Var}(f)\frac{\log n}{30n}\le\operatorname{Inf}_i(f)$, where variance and
coordinate influence are computed under that measure.
\end{lemma}

\difficulty{5}
There is a constant $c>0$ such that, for every natural number $n$ and every function
$f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ taking only the values $-1$ and $1$, one has
$c\,\operatorname{Var}(f)\,\frac{\log n}{n}\le M(f)$, where variance and coordinate
influences are computed under the uniform measure and $M(f)$ is the supremum of the
absolute coordinate influences (with the empty supremum interpreted as $0$).
\end{theorem}

\difficulty{6}
There is a constant $C>0$ such that for every natural number $n$ and every function
$f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ taking values in $\{-1,1\}$ and having variance at least $1/2$
under the uniform measure, there is a nonempty set $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ such
that $|S|\le C I(f)$ and $\exp(-C I(f)^2)\le\widehat f(S)^2$. Here $I(f)$ is the total
influence and $\widehat f(S)$ is the uniform Fourier–Walsh coefficient at $S$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Balanced KKL coordinate bound]
\lean{KKL.KKL_balanced}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.cubeVariance, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.exists_influence_ge_kkl_bound, BooleanAnalysis.expect, BooleanAnalysis.influence, BooleanAnalysis.isPmOne, KKL.expect_sq_pm_one}
\statementsource{Analysis-of-Boolean-Functions-by-Ryan-ODonnell}{pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p097-b006}
\difficulty{4}
\proofsource{boolean-ch09-hypercontractivity-kkl}{
  pdf-4ba63c9394e5-p019-b004,
  pdf-4ba63c9394e5-p021-b002,
  pdf-4ba63c9394e5-p021-b004,
  pdf-4ba63c9394e5-p022-b001
}
\label{KKL.KKL_balanced}
\statementsource{boolean-ch10-advanced-hypercontractivity}{
  pdf-9d1751394783-p012-b002,
  pdf-9d1751394783-p012-b003
}
\statementsource{boolean-ch09-hypercontractivity-kkl}{
  pdf-4ba63c9394e5-p019-b004,
  pdf-4ba63c9394e5-p021-b001,
  pdf-4ba63c9394e5-p021-b002,
  pdf-4ba63c9394e5-p021-b004,
  pdf-4ba63c9394e5-p022-b001,
  pdf-4ba63c9394e5-p022-b002
}
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube with $n\ge2$ and
$\mathbb Ef=0$. Some coordinate $i$ satisfies $I_i(f)\ge\log n/(30n)$. For a real cube
function $h$, define $I_i(h)=\tfrac14\mathbb E_x(h(x)-h(x^{(i)}))^2$, where $x^{(i)}$
flips coordinate $i$ and $\mathbb E_x$ is uniform expectation.
\end{theorem}
